clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Taurajo, Betrayal from Within begins with Mangletooth's offer of bloody vengeance. Imprisoned in a cage, the quilboar says his kin left him for dead. He offers Horde travelers knowledge of the three Razormane warlords who emerged from Razorfen Kraul to organize assaults across the Barrens.

At Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth has lost all loyalty to his Razormane kin. They left him behind in defeat, and he faces execution in his cage. Now he wants vengeance against the leaders who abandoned him. He offers Horde travelers knowledge of the true architects behind the ruthless raids across the plains.

Razormane attacks keep troubling the Horde, and Thork at the Crossroads struggles to curb them. Mangletooth names three commanders from deep within Razorfen Kraul: Lok Orcbane, a formidable warrior, and his companions Nak, a tracker, and Kuz, a spellcaster. They direct Razormane raiders from encampments far to the south. Mangletooth demands their severed skulls as proof that his betrayers have fallen before his own end arrives.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Three of my tribe came out of the Kraul to lead the raids against the Horde, traveler. They are ruthless and cunning, and if you defeat them, then your Crossroads and even most of the Barrens will learn peace... At least from the Razormane tribe.

Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are the ones you seek. They are far to the south of the Barrens. One is a spell caster, another a tracker, and their leader, the one called Orcbane, a warrior. Kill them, traveler, like they have killed me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Thork thinks he knows the truth about who leads the raids against his people, but he shall learn how wrong he is if you are successful.
My death is inescapable, but you have caused great pain to my enemies, so Mangletooth regrets nothing.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is done then. Better it ends this way, says Mangletooth. They should have made sure I was dead when they turned their backs on me instead of leaving me here in this forsaken cage.
There is but one task left for you to finish, traveler.
